admission.justification: The obligation is asserted by its own cases and its failure would let the send-back act on a seat that is working or limited; its one realization is deliberate, so it claims no span.

applicability: Every message to a limited recipient on role_message, the developer's tray send and report_to_architect.
conditions: The message is held with the reason and the reset time, also when the recipient is idle.
It is released by the first sweep after the reset, in order, when the recipient is ready.
An archived recipient found through the publication's ended stamp is still answered, and a closed session keeps its messages waiting.
exclusions: The presenter's send is out of scope, because it holds no role seat.
No text matching decides the hold.
A wait call answers held at once and does not wait.
statement: A message to a limited seat waits for the reset and is released the moment the seat can take it.
